labels.name: man5 — the shipped 5-way tactical target
labels.valid_note: defined on every window with a full 2 s future; no mask
labels.degenerate_definition: LOSSY = lateral class is a turn AND longitudinal class is live, so the priority collapse destroys the longitudinal decision and no decode rule recovers it
labels.denominator: 9203 windows / 400 episodes, stride 8, v2 gate (train sample); 2301 windows / 100 episodes gives 16.60 %
labels.cross_check: the SAME quantity measured on the canonical 40-ep val at stride 5 is 132/1364 = 9.68 % (…/2026-08-03-dtac1-tactical-head/dtac1_probe_refc-base-30k.json). The two DIFFER because the populations differ, not because the definition does — see route_gate_speed_probe.json.

labels.name: lat x lon — the FACTORED tactical target
labels.consumed_by: stack/scripts/refc_train.py behind RefCConfig.factored_maneuver (DEFAULT FALSE — no published run has it on)
labels.projection_identity: collapse(lat, lon) == the shipped 5-way label on 11,504 / 11,504 windows (0 mismatches). MEASURED — this is what makes the switch a refinement rather than a relabel.

labels.name: route — the strategic 3-class target (v2.1)
labels.n_classes: 3 + ROUTE_UNKNOWN sentinel (deliberately out of CE range)
labels.within_clip: 5.4 % of episodes carry a CONSTANT route; mean 2.36 distinct classes and only 1.49 switches per ~23-window episode. Coarse and slowly varying, NOT a pure clip tag.
known_defects: the turn share (65.5 % tight_transient) is dominated by the SPEED MIX: turn rate 76.9 % at 3-6 m/s vs 2.5 % at 10-15 m/s
the transience gate is inert on 96.0 % of windows (arc < TRANSIENCE_MIN_ARC_M 150 m) — but re-enabling it at 60 m moves only 1.0 % of windows (route_v21_vs_v22_ab.json), so it is NOT the cause
no distance-to-manoeuvre: turn-labelled windows sit 0-200 m from the turn (d_now 32.9 %, d_50_100 18.2 %, d_100_200 6.3 %) and all carry the same token

labels.name: nav_cmd — the strategic MODEL INPUT
labels.degenerate_definition: ROUTE_UNKNOWN collapsed onto NAV_FOLLOW by _ROUTE_TO_NAV.get(route, NAV_FOLLOW) — indistinguishable at the input from a real road_following judgement
labels.denominator: 3179 windows fed `follow` out of 9203; 1985 of them (62.44 %) are the collapsed sentinel
labels.fixed_by: nav_command_v21_ex (provenance) and nav_input_v22 (the (command, known) pair) — added 2026-08-03

labels.name: route_gt — the MAP-DERIVED strategic label (NuRec OpenDRIVE)
labels.n_classes: LEFT / STRAIGHT / RIGHT / UTURN, per DECISION EVENT with an option set and a distance
labels.coverage: 141 T1 candidates -> 141 labelled -> 110 admissible (31 refused by the map-vs-realised-heading control) -> 78 with >= 1 scoreable decision -> 77 actually scored, 116-117 events, 4745 poses
labels.evidence_class: MEASURED (this stream loaded results/strategic_gt/*.json and the 141-file strategic_gt_t1.tar.gz)
labels.why_it_matters: this is the ONLY strategic label in the programme that is not a function of the ego's own future trajectory. Every kinematic route label is circular in exactly the way the C6 confound describes.
labels.not_parity: NuRec is a different corpus; it can validate the kinematic label, it cannot replace it inside the parity arm.

labels.name: situation labels — lane_change / intersection / roundabout
labels.coverage: 14.0 % of train episodes contain a lane change, 50.5 % contain an intersection event (400 eps); val 12.0 % / 45.0 % (100 eps)
labels.known_defect_FIXED: alon_pre / omega_pre were built on np.gradient (CENTRED) under a STRICTLY CAUSAL comment. |centred - causal| differs on 91.3 % of frames; mean 0.0307 m/s^2 (4.53 % of the mean |alon_pre|) and 0.00306 rad/s (3.26 %); max 0.611 m/s^2 and 0.0750 rad/s. Fixed 2026-08-03 via situations.backward_diff.

labels.reason: the episode record stores only {frames_u8, actions, poses, episode_id, maneuvers}. There is no lead-agent track, so no headway, time-gap or TTC can be computed from any existing cache.
labels.evidence_class: MEASURED (loaded an episode and enumerated its keys)
labels.source_exists: obstacle.offline carries 3D agent tracks on 97.44 % of the source corpus and is NOT read by the episode builder — physicalai.py reads 4 of 36 features.
labels.work_item: joining obstacle.offline at build time is the single highest-value corpus upgrade for the LONGITUDINAL family the PI made binding, and it is a RE-CACHE (same episodes), not a re-selection.
